origin.source: Ported in spirit from v1 verify.ts (next branch)

comparison.purpose: An input/output guardrail chain authored as explicit gate states: validate the question (answerable? in scope?) before generating, answer, verify the answer, then revise-or-fail. Contrasts with evaluator-optimizer's refinement loop: guardrails gate rather than refine — an out-of-scope question is refused before any answer is generated, and an unsupported answer is revised at most once then flagged as unverified, never silently returned.
